root_cause.text: A bounds-check bug in `crypto/af_alg.c::af_alg_pull_tsgl()` let the page-reassignment loop in AF_ALG scatterlist handling reassign one more page than needed because the condition did not stop reassignment when `plen` reached zero.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (dst)` to `if (dst && plen)` and updates the comment from “reassign page to dst after offset” to “reassign page to dst,” while the commit message says “the original loop wasn't updated so it may try to reassign one more page than necessary,” confirming the missing `plen` check in `af_alg_pull_tsgl` caused the overflow.

intent_record.intent_summary: Skip scatterlist page reassignment when the segment length is zero to avoid invalid zero-length entries.
intent_record.what: In af_alg_pull_tsgl(), the conditional guarding the destination scatterlist assignment changed from `if (dst)` to `if (dst && plen)`, and the accompanying comment was shortened from `/* reassign page to dst after offset */` to `/* reassign page to dst */`.
intent_record.how: This prevents the code from calling `get_page()` and `sg_set_page()` when the computed page length `plen` is zero, avoiding creation of zero-length scatterlist entries and unnecessary page reference manipulation during pull operations.

grouping_result.intent: Skip scatterlist page reassignment when the segment length is zero to avoid invalid zero-length entries.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the root cause: it adds a stop condition for zero-length segments in AF_ALG scatterlist page reassignment, preventing the loop from reassigning an extra page when plen reaches zero.

candidates.rationale: This conditional allows the page-reassignment path to run without checking whether the current segment length is zero. The root cause says the loop should stop reassignment when plen reaches zero, so this is the pre-fix guard that failed to prevent the extra reassignment.
